subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding that some purchases are planned in advance while impulse purchases are made without thinking ahead
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to the Discipline Pillar — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student role-plays a scenario resisting an impulse purchase in favor of a planned savings goal
exercise.pictorial: Student sorts purchase examples into 'planned' and 'impulse' categories
exercise.abstract: Student explains one reason planned purchases usually work out better than impulse purchases

misconception_flags: cannot identify any real downside to frequent impulse purchases

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
